name: Eric Mulder

summary.text: Wayne Harlos, Mulder's running mate, also ran for Lieutenant Governor of Colorado on the Libertarian ticket in the 2020 election, according to Ballotpedia.
Eric Mulder is a U.S. Army veteran, security guard and small business owner from Aurora who previously served on Aurora's Veterans Affairs Commission and Civic Engagement Commission.

experience.text: Member, Aurora Civic Engagement Commission; previously served on the Aurora Veterans Affairs Commission.

sources.title: Eric Mulder for Colorado Governor (campaign site)

research_notes: Mulder's 2026 campaign site is mostly a placeholder/signup page with no issues content reachable by automated fetch; his Libertarian Party press release (lpcolorado.org) was blocked by a bot-detection challenge page. His Ballotpedia 2026 Candidate Connection survey gave three key messages (keeping state sales tax revenue local during emergencies, limiting government surveillance/privacy, and energy diversity) but only the energy answer maps clearly to one of the 25 statements. A separate 2024 Ballotpedia survey response exists from a different race (an Aurora-area state legislative campaign, not governor) and was not used here to avoid conflating offices. No endorsements beyond crowd-sourced 'Sway' voting-group listings were found.
